data.one_liner: A lightweight alternative to Scaffold for avoiding the on-screen software keyboard.
data.what_it_does: Automatically adjusts its padding to avoid the on-screen keyboard and can scroll obscured TextField child widgets into view on focus. It can be applied selectively to specific widgets rather than requiring a full-screen Scaffold.
use_when: You want to avoid the on-screen software keyboard without using a full-screen Scaffold
You need to automatically scroll focused TextFields into view
You want to inset padding only by the actual amount obscured by the keyboard
avoid_when: You are already satisfied with the default behavior of Flutter's built-in Scaffold resize properties
You need sophisticated layout engines not covered by standard single-child scroll views
strengths: Selectively applied to specific areas rather than the whole screen
Supports auto-scrolling focused child widgets into view
weaknesses: Limited configuration options documented beyond basic properties like autoScroll
Relies on standard ScrollView wrapping when autoScroll is enabled
